headline: Clean day; two tests closed, kinetic captions restored, and PR #8 is waiting on you.
happened: Three Shorts and three rapid-fires went out on Nov 18, all green.
The judge closed the closing-line test: the score ask stays.
The judge closed the cry test: modern cries stay.
You restored kinetic captions as the baseline today.

decisions.title: Merge PR #8: Pokémon-or-medicine, slowed cries, Pokédex-first test?
decisions.why: Previews are rendered and the intro and voice fixes you asked for are in; nothing goes live until you say so.
options: Merge without slowed cries (51 s is long)

ideas: Move Starter, Water and Generation 1 themes to rapid-fire only, because they do several times better there than as single Shorts.
Stop the Facebook cross-post, because 156 posts have reached nobody.
watch: Episode numbers lead by ten points and are five videos from a decision.
The analytics job runs 7 to 10 hours late, so morning figures are a day old.
ElevenLabs balance could not be read this morning.
changes: Closing-line and cry tests decided; the hint-count test is now running.
